Raknetify2 for Velocity and Forge 1.20.1

Copy the two JARs in velocity/plugins to your Velocity plugins directory.
Copy the two JARs in forge-server/mods to the Forge 1.20.1 backend mods directory.
Replace older copies of the same components. Install the Raknetify2 Forge 1.20.1
JAR in each player's Forge profile for UDP connections.

Set announce-forge = true and player-info-forwarding-mode = "modern" in
velocity.toml. Keep online-mode = true on an Internet-facing proxy. Configure
the backend in Velocity's servers list. Set online-mode=false on the backend
and restrict its listener to the proxy. Use loopback when they share a host.
In the backend config/proxy-compatible-forge.toml set forwarding.enabled to
true, forwarding.mode to "MODERN" and forwarding.secret to the value from the
proxy's forwarding-secret-file. Each installation supplies its own secret.
Enable crossStitch.enabled for modded command arguments.

Start both services. Allow TCP and UDP on the public proxy port. Players enter
raknet; followed by the proxy address. A successful UDP login appears in the
Velocity log with the player's name and the negotiated RakNet MTU.

Ambassador and Proxy Compatible Forge are distributed under LGPL-2.1-or-later.
The sources directory contains the corresponding upstream release sources and
license notices. The Raknetify2 distributions contain their MIT license notices.
